results.reasoning: 강한 충동을 experience + neurological(신경) disorder + itchiness(가려움). → experience—neurological—itchiness = ②.
mild cases → relieve(완화) + severe RLS → more challenging. → mild—relieve—severe = ①.
no cure + permanent condition + help people manage symptoms → permanent—cure—manage = ③.
②rarely → commonly. most commonly occurs(가장 흔히). ①urge, ③symptoms, ④challenging 적절.
④temporary → permanent. 영구적(permanent) 질환. temporary(일시적)는 반대. ①relieve, ②mystery, ③cured 적절.
①eliminate → manage. 증상을 관리(manage). eliminate(제거)는 과도. ②genetic, ③cure, ④cured 적절.
People with _____ cases can relieve symptoms by walking → mild(경미한). severe/permanent/genetic 부적절.
make sitting through a movie nearly _____ → impossible(불가능). manageable(반대맥락), challenging(중복), permanent(부적절).
Why RLS happens is still a _____ → mystery(수수께끼). cure/condition/symptom 부적절.
severe = intense(심한). mild(반의어), moderate(보통의), slight(약간의) 부적절.
relieve = alleviate(완화하다). aggravate(악화)/intensify(강화)/maintain(유지) 부적절.
occur = happen(발생하다). vanish(사라지다)/prevent(예방)/cease(멈추다) 부적절.
permanent(영구적) ↔ temporary(일시적). lasting/constant/enduring은 동의어.
challenging(힘든) ↔ effortless(수월한). demanding/difficult/arduous는 동의어.
(A) on one condition = 조건. (B) genetic condition = 질환. → (A)조건 (B)질환 = ③.
physical sign that shows disease/health problem = symptom(증상). syndrome/condition/mystery 부적절.
disorder _____ as RLS → 과거분사 후치수식 = known(알려진). know→known.
have been _____ = 현재완료진행형 have been + V-ing → sitting. sit→sitting.
It can cause _____, leading to daytime tiredness → sleep problems(수면 문제). genetic condition/neurological disorder/permanent condition 부적절.
It might be a _____ condition → genetic(유전적). neurological(앞에 언급됨), permanent(뒤에 별도언급), psychological(근거없음).
